blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The exact earnUSD implementation has account-level isBlacklisted checks and role-gated setAccountInfo, plus configurable mint/burn/transfer pause and whitelist flags. At block 26107703, current flags were zero; absence of an active pause does not remove configurable holder restrictions. The implementation is upgradeable. Because the full current role-grant/execution census is not closed, direct holder blacklisting is recorded as possible, not an observed historical freeze or an inference from the USDC parent.

oracleRisk.summary: earnUSD queue and share valuation uses the deployed Lido internal Oracle reporting model: trusted roles submit prices, accept suspicious reports and alter validation intervals. The actor registry names an Oracle Updater Safe, observed 3-of-8, but no independent external-feed or global protective-delay claim is made. The known privileged top-level report path is not a verified exemption for the earnUSDc/earnUSDe downstream strategy pricing; those remain explicitly unresolved.
